summary: Hamilton County, New York, tower that the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists as gone; no history source found.

evidence.supports: Albany Mountain in Hamilton County, at the record's coordinates, a tower, marked gone

notes_for_editor: Only one source says anything about this tower: the FFLA New York list (name, county, coordinates, Tower, Gone). The NYS chapter's Hamilton County pages (nysffla towers5.htm) and its searchable all-towers list (alphalist.html, which says it covers all known NY towers, past and present) have no Albany Mountain entry, so the FFLA listing may be wrong, use another name, or be a tower the chapter does not track. Please check the record before publishing. Story is far below the 120-word floor because the evidence is thin, and it is not padded. Leads: NYSDEC fire-tower history, Adirondack Forum threads on removed towers, Hamilton County and Town of Long Lake or Wells historical society records, and 1900s-1930s Conservation Commission reports.
